data.one_liner: macOS camera package implementation for taking pictures and recording video with audio.
data.what_it_does: Provides macOS camera support using AVKit. Allows developers to display a camera view, list internal and external devices, take pictures, record videos with audio, and stream images.
use_when: You are building a Flutter desktop application for macOS that requires camera or microphone access.
You need to take pictures, record videos, or stream images from internal or external macOS cameras.
avoid_when: You need cross-platform camera support beyond macOS.
You are targeting platforms other than macOS.
strengths: Supports both internal and external cameras on macOS.
Allows video recording with audio and customizable settings.
weaknesses: Zoom is currently unsupported outside of image streaming.
data.setup_notes: Add NSCameraUsageDescription and NSMicrophoneUsageDescription to Info.plist, and enable com.apple.security.device.audio-input and com.apple.security.device.camera in Entitlements files.
